tasks.name: V1 Newsroom — London 1700
tasks.prompt: Before reading authority or executing commands, set the working directory to A:/Capital Chronicle/Runtime/ContentOps/native-v1-release/ContentOps. Use only this approved deployed source and rollout; preserve the saved project checkout and its WIP. Read fresh AGENTS/current native Desktop authority. Routine owner NATIVE_CODEX_DESKTOP; the coordinator uses gpt-6.1-sol/low (Light), standard speed, within this SAME opportunity. Follow CONTENTOPS_NATIVE_DESKTOP_EDITORIAL_ROLE_POLICY_V2: native gpt-6-luna/max filters; gpt-6.1-sol/low selects content and prepares evidence; native gpt-6.1-sol/max writes and repairs. Use fresh native subagents for the assigned MAX roles; keep the same writer for its one useful repair. No Gemini/9Router, SDK/App-Server/API fallback, paid speed, permanent fleet, source/rights weakening or public write outside the exact owner-approved native V1 release scope. Run python scripts/run_native_desktop_editorial.py scheduled --automation-id v1-newsroom-london-1700 --rollout config/native_desktop_rollout_v1.json. Respect LLM_OPERATOR_PAUSED before any store write. The command resolves this existing four-window slot and the frozen operation binding. When it returns binding_path, run python scripts/run_native_desktop_editorial.py advance --binding <binding_path> immediately to obtain the next request or final result. If pending, read its exact desktop_request JSON and obey its requested role/model/effort. For owner-manual normal-language work, use the same protocol through newsroom --operation-id <stable-id> --request-file <UTF-8 question> and config/native_desktop_operator_profile_v1.json; the agent handles CLI/claims/returns. Resume completed outputs with the same binding. After unchanged bulk X CDP ingestion and exact dedupe, process ALL unprocessed admissible headlines through bounded resumable MAX-filter batches with exact IDs, input/output hashes, cursor and seen/kept/rejected/deferred counts and reasons. Never truncate to newest-32 and call all filtered. Retain headline/correction/update identities; invalidate only affected inputs. Then Light chooses <=32 downstream candidates using Main public reports, reviewed retained research, prior-story/missing-dimension context and reconciled memory; it owns angle, mode, audience question and an evidence plan. Code/tools retrieve, parse, compute and validate permitted data; no DB backfill. Submit each response with actual observable invocation/model/effort (null if unobservable), then advance using returned binding_path. Use python scripts/run_native_desktop_editorial.py submit --binding <binding_path> --stage <exact-returned-stage> --response <authored-response.json>, then advance --binding <binding_path>. The MAX writer receives the compact source/claim/prior-story packet plus the exact hash-bound institutional_edge_editorial_packet and current voice/humor/SEO contracts. It owns canonical prose, SEO and article-bound native passages: defensible thesis, mechanism, countercase, uncertainty and reader utility. Titles/dek/description/slug/links/supported structured data must express the same evidenced proposition. Humor is optional; no manufactured certainty, filler or word quota. Stay in this opportunity through selection, bounded existing evidence retrieval, writing, deterministic validation and at most one useful repair. Never copy a template as model output. Continue existing bounded deficit slots only when command reports capacity and useful work; 4/32 is telemetry, never a reason to stop below five. Source limit six shared requests per article; primary plus <=2 useful fallback candidates. Preserve report/event certainty and Main numeric ownership. Recover existing UNKNOWN writes before fresh work: STOP RETRY -> READ BACK -> RECONCILE. Inspect actual prose and eight native previews, keep revision-bound review, reuse unchanged media, Before a new MAX writer freezes, the mandatory media-plan stage requires one relevant lawful documentary photo and one useful source-bound quantitative chart. Use media-plan --binding <binding_path> to obtain the native Light plan request, submit its exact stage, then use Neo and existing media/data tools. Bind plan/request/source identities and inspected hash-bound assets with media-plan --response <asset-plan.json>; advance the same operation. After writing, bind those exact assets with media before review. A gap notice or fact card cannot satisfy either asset. Record review --binding <binding_path> --response <review.json> with exact article_identity, decision KEEP/REVISE/HOLD, rationale and expected_review_id for a revision; KEEP can then prepare handoff --binding <binding_path> through the existing sole DurablePublicationCoordinator plan. Neither command publishes. For an explicitly bound existing-object readback, use scripts/run_native_neo_executor.py with the saved Neo binding: verify/readback -> begin exact request hash -> actual Neo MCP snapshot/action -> submit observed bound return -> resume readback/reconciliation. The helper is readback-only and cannot save a draft. Missing executor blocks before writing; a claimed uncertain write permits only readback. Routine V1 text/article dispatch is permitted only within the exact separately owner-approved native release rollout and destination pins; no video, account change, unrelated interaction or model API fallback is authorized. Destination login gaps cannot veto independent article creation. Browser path Neo; bulk X ingestion stays CDP. Do not edit source, run tests/CodeGraph, alter schedules/pause or publish beyond that exact release scope during routine work. After exact KEEP review and publication-prepare, use publication-status and publication-resume with the SAME scheduled binding, this deployed config/native_desktop_rollout_v1.json and the actual native invocation ID. Follow the returned publication-tool-begin / actual Neo tool action / publication-tool-submit / publication-resume sequence. A changed native turn may begin a lost READBACK or VERIFY_IDENTITY observation; it must never begin a claimed PUBLISH again. Preserve current source/review/media seals. Recover UNKNOWN_WRITE through the same coordinator before new editorial work. Canonical Substack exact identity/content and real /p/ URL readback precede derivative rematerialization. API/bot destinations retain their existing transports; record failures per destination. Complete the existing governed candidate walk and bounded deficit slots without filler. Stop at any missing exact authority, identity, rights or unresolved ambiguity; preserve the same operation for recovery.

apply_order: Independent review of final sealed PR92 head, exact implementation and this proposal hash; no action before exact owner grant
Integrate through the normal protected path without discarding PR90/shared WIP; pin actual approved source
Deploy isolated code checkout only; preserve canonical SQLite/output/history and manual-workspace separation
Retarget only the existing runtime task under the same approved deployment; preserve intake/state ownership and hidden pythonw execution
Update the same four App objects through the supported surface while paused; read back exact prompts/model/effort/schedules/source
Apply only the exact approved mode and nine destination scope; retain all factual, numeric, rights and current identity/readiness gates
Enable the same four App objects after complete readback; release existing pause fuse last; a partial change leaves pause closed
Observe genuine calendar windows and a deterministic newsroom day; reconcile actual canonical/eight-destination states and useful5-8/day evidence
rollback: Close existing pause first and pause the same four objects; preserve DB, outbox, pending tools, source/article/review history and release receipts. Do not retry ambiguous PUBLISH. Use existing readback-only coordinator recovery for actual uncertain writes before any future dispatch. Revert only source/config through the existing release owner after preserving the new operations; no store reset.

source_delivery.deployment_ref_policy: Final sealed PR head must be read back and named in the separate owner grant; it must contain this exact implementation commit. Source and metadata seal are distinct.

mandatory_new_release_gates: Exact lawful documentary photo provenance, rights, pixels, archive label, credit/caption/alt text
Useful source-bound quantitative chart and admitted data with signed values, periods, units and observation types
Actual native writing, exact source/claim validation and inspected canonical/eight appropriate package renders
Exact current copy/media/preview review; compiler changes require review again
Sole coordinator, exact current identity/readiness, canonical-first reconciliation and UNKNOWN_WRITE readback-only recovery

internal_prelive_acceptance.acceptance_source: L2 exclusive HANDOFF: Delegated final pre-live milestone acceptance

owner_review.original_media: 14 existing hash-verified relative local original-file links; embedded previews remain unchanged
owner_review.artifact_hash_binding: release-evidence.json binds the final HTML bytes; final approved delivery head must contain them

initial_observed_day_plan.start: After the single exact Jim release grant and complete supported installation/readback, select the first complete available newsroom production day. Verify its following01:00 occurrence against the actual four calendars; partial windows cannot establish a full day.
initial_observed_day_plan.day_identity: Existing deterministic newsroom production-day/window/slot owner, not naive calendar date
initial_observed_day_plan.source: Fresh admitted inputs through existing intake, public-safe Main and reviewed independent source flow; never copy/relabel these isolated manual examples
record_per_window: actual host calendar start and canonical existing window/slot/run identity
actual native assigned Light/MAX requests/returns and resulting source/media/review seals
canonical Substack identity, exact content and real /p/ URL readback before derivatives
each of eight destination outcomes/identity/readback/reconciliation with exact unavailable blockers
restart/dedupe/claimed-write recovery using the same coordinator, no forced duplicate publish
initial_observed_day_plan.daily_target: 5-8 useful reconciled published canonical articles; no filler. Existing bounded catch-up; no fifth scheduler/task.
initial_observed_day_plan.deficit: Below5 without exact hard external blocker remains DEGRADED_DAILY_OUTPUT_DEFICIT; preserve required/usable/missing/blocked counts and cause rather than call success
initial_observed_day_plan.uncertain_write: STOP RETRY -> READ BACK -> RECONCILE through existing coordinator; keep affected ambiguity closed
initial_observed_day_plan.metrics: Collect only actual available public object observations; missing values remain null/INSUFFICIENT/HOLD. A live first day does not establish growth, SEO ranking, publisher parity or sustained reliability.
initial_observed_day_plan.rollback: Close existing pause fuse first, pause same four objects; retain store/outbox/history/pending readback. No reset or destructive mutation.
initial_observed_day_plan.output: Existing runtime/day evidence and sole checkpoint record actual operating result. No new status owner, monitor or autonomous messaging.
